hash_scope: Four upstream file digests bind pinned public upstream bytes retained in licensed private vendor custody. Repository-config digests bind published masked stdout. Public verification compares stream digests; the co-op separately checks private raw bytes against vendor copies.
historical_gap: Original C26/C27/C29/C30 did not capture input file bytes at their run time. Current snapshots cannot retroactively prove their historical inputs. Those runs are retained with this named GAP; new C44/C45/C47/C48 have before-read and after-cmp evidence.

bindings.method: Native cat records the actual file before smoke; native cmp --silent after smoke compares that fixture path with retained raw cat bytes. verify_bindings.py compares source/read stream sha256 values and the fixed binding digest, checks source/read/smoke/compare timing and return codes, and binds cat/cmp/smoke argv plus smoke cwd. GNU diffutils 3.12 cmp: status 0 means no differences, 1 differences, 2 trouble; --silent prints nothing (official manual read 2026-10-16: https://www.gnu.org/software/diffutils/manual/html_node/Invoking-cmp.html and https://www.gnu.org/software/diffutils/manual/html_node/cmp-Options.html). Version is captured in C58; historical executable identity is not retroactively established.
